unverified: No real fetch was run: any call downloads the whole 1.29 GB cyclic file regardless of variable count. Checked instead by HTTP range reads of the remote file header: SOLIN, SST, ICEFRAC, co2vmr_3d present with shape (1460, 192, 288), noleap 6-hourly time axis starting 2000-01-01, grid matches CAMULATOR_GRID_LAT/LON. Only the dry run passed.
notes: Variables are CAMulator FORCING_VARIABLES (models/px/camulator.py:78), fetched each step at :445.

Unlike SamudrACE, the file is downloaded with local_dir=self.cache (camulator.py:299-301), i.e. under EARTH2STUDIO_CACHE/camulator, so the harness wipe gives a cold trial (the class docstring's HF_HOME statement is wrong).
Cyclic mode matches month/day/hour so any 6-hourly date works; mode='transient' would download 9.7 GB.
Expect roughly 1.3 GB per trial; time is dominated by the download.
